review_basis.purpose: Declare one memory space’s owner, purpose, allowed subjects, storage boundary, authority, privacy class, schema, and lifecycle.
Keep observations, facts, claims, preferences, decisions, goals, procedures, failures, evidence, drafts, and personal context as distinct memory classes.
Bind every remembered item to who or what supplied it, what authority they had, and what the source can and cannot prove.
Limit capture, retention, retrieval, sharing, training, export, and expiry through an exact revocable human permission.
Keep human identity, AI identity, temporary role, device, provider, session, and delegated authority separate across continuity.
Record entity, activity, agent, derivation, generation, use, timestamps, environment, and evidence references for one memory object.
Preserve source material independently from summaries, extracted fields, model interpretations, and later conclusions.
Represent unknown, disputed, inferred, observed, verified, stale, retracted, and human-confirmed states without one misleading score.
Prevent a memory collected for one declared purpose from silently gaining authority in another workflow.
Track candidate, active, monitor, manual-review, superseded, retired, revoked, expired, quarantined, and deleted-reference states.
Record additions, corrections, decisions, retractions, and state transitions as new events instead of rewriting prior history.
Link immutable memory events through exact digests so missing, reordered, or modified history becomes visible.
Identify immutable memory objects by canonical content digest and reuse exact duplicates without merging their provenance.
Create a new memory revision with exact parent, author, reason, schema, content digest, and changed-field evidence.
Track compatible, additive, breaking, hotfix, and schema migration history independently from human approval or canonical status.
Store the exact base values and preconditions used by a partial memory update so later rebase safety can be evaluated.
Seal the old state, requested transition, authority, checks, resulting state, refusal reasons, and time for every lifecycle change.
Represent generated-by, derived-from, used, informed-by, attributed-to, and associated-with relationships without inventing causation.
Distinguish byte-identical, canonical-identical, semantically similar, and genuinely separate memories while preserving source lineage.
Append every human-selected known-good memory or state pointer while preserving prior selections and refusing install or canon authority.
Preserve source time while recording timezone, monotonic or wall-clock basis, precision, conversion, and uncertainty.
Detect unreliable ordering across sessions or devices and retain partial order, sequence, and uncertainty instead of forcing one timeline.
Choose bounded checkpoints around important decisions, merges, builds, handoffs, interruptions, and risk transitions.
Define exactly which files, records, identities, settings, dependencies, and exclusions belong to a continuity snapshot.
Bind a memory operation or restore proposal to the exact current state, revision, content digests, and environment it assumes.
Show what a restore would add, replace, preserve, conflict with, omit, or invalidate before any memory state changes.
Identify missing sessions, unexplained jumps, absent parent events, broken references, unknown decisions, and unaccounted state changes.
Record incomplete work, last durable checkpoint, pending actions, active locks, uncertain outputs, and safe re-entry needs after interruption.
Seal what entered, changed, remained unresolved, was exported, was retained, and must be restored at the end of one session.
Retrieve memory as it was known at a selected time, revision, checkpoint, or decision boundary rather than only the latest view.
Create a bounded branch with exact base, purpose, owner, expected lifetime, merge target, and no automatic authority over its parent.
Report changes made independently since a shared base across facts, goals, constraints, decisions, files, and state.
Compare base, current, and proposed branches and produce a reviewable merge plan without writing canonical state.
Hold updates that modify the same semantic path or depend on incompatible witnesses while preserving both proposals.
Find claims that cannot simultaneously hold under the same scope, time, definitions, and source assumptions.
Preserve conflicting credible sources, their scopes, dates, evidence strength, and unresolved status without forced consensus.
Append rejected, minority, uncertain, and challenger views with reasons, evidence, and conditions for reconsideration.
Mark a memory as replaced, corrected, retracted, or limited while retaining the original and exact reason.
Record who resolved a conflict, what alternatives existed, why one path was selected, limits, dissent, and reopening conditions.
Package the shared base, divergent operations, evidence, and expected holds so merge behavior can be reproduced and tested.
Compress temporary branches aggressively while protecting roots, authority boundaries, dissent, unresolved risk, and source links.
Produce a compact meaning-preserving summary with named omissions, uncertainty, intended audience, and source checkpoint.
Bind every summary section to exact underlying records so the summary never becomes the sole memory authority.
Restore current goal, active direction, latest checkpoint, key decisions, open risks, pending actions, and relevant source pointers for a new session.
Identify the currently approved direction separately from historical possibilities, abandoned paths, and future ideas.
Track unfinished tasks, promises, questions, dependencies, expected returns, deadlines, and explicit cancellation state.
Preserve unanswered, disputed, blocked, and research-needed questions without allowing a summary to imply closure.
Condense a decision into context, options, evidence, trade-offs, authority, dissent, consequences, and reopening trigger.
Select the smallest sufficient memory set for one task using relevance, authority, freshness, risk, diversity, and token or compute limits.
Compare a compressed memory against source records to detect omitted constraints, inverted meaning, invented certainty, and consensus inflation.
Combine exact identifiers, structured fields, full text, embeddings, temporal filters, and graph relationships while exposing the route used.
Rank memories by task time, validity window, recency, checkpoint, supersession, and historical relevance rather than newest-only bias.
Rank candidate memories using source role, directness, native evidence, verification, scope, and known limits without hiding lower-ranked dissent.
Mark memory stale when its source, environment, dependency, policy, person preference, or validity window changes.
Return supporting, conflicting, superseding, and uncertain memories together when a query touches disputed knowledge.
Include materially different evidence and interpretations rather than returning only the dominant repeated phrasing.
Record query, filters, index version, candidate set, selection reasons, omitted categories, and returned memory digests.
Route identity, project, sensory, failure, preference, decision, evidence, and module memories to the correct bounded stores and consumers.
Hold invalid, corrupted, untrusted, privacy-crossing, schema-unknown, or dangerously stale memory outside active retrieval.
Recommend deletable duplicates, expired raw material, replaceable caches, and low-value detail while requiring retention and human review rules.
Declare which memory classes may be retained, for how long, for which purpose, by which store, and under what revocation conditions.
Block raw private conversations, sensory material, temporary reasoning, and unrelated context from durable memory unless explicitly approved.
Classify public, internal, private, personal, secret, identity, location, health-like, legal-like, and high-risk memory with visible uncertainty.
Retain only the minimum fields, precision, duration, and identifying detail required for the approved continuity purpose.
Record what was removed, transformed, generalized, or masked, why, by whom, and how the redacted memory relates to its protected source.
Keep encrypted payloads, key identifiers, rotation, recovery, access roles, and secret-free metadata as separate governed surfaces.
Expire raw material, derived caches, permissions, temporary branches, and proof references through explicit policy and auditable receipts.
Propagate revoked permission to retrieval, sharing, derived views, exports, training candidates, and future processing without pretending impossible erasure occurred.
Export selected memories, provenance, schemas, relationships, proofs, permissions, encryption notes, and limitations into a self-verifying local package.
Record deletion scope, authority, affected copies, remaining references, retention exceptions, and proof without retaining the deleted private content.
Transfer approved goal, context, decisions, open loops, evidence, boundaries, and next actions between sessions without hidden memory authority.
Create and verify a portable re-entry packet for a new conversation while separating supplied history from model memory claims.
Give each AI seat only the scoped memory, role, sources, permissions, task contract, and unresolved questions needed for one assignment.
Move a content-addressed bounded memory subset to a phone, handheld, worker, or private machine with expiry and acceptance receipts.
Carry operations, ancestry, replica identity, schemas, permissions, and conflict evidence between disconnected local nodes.
Assign stable local replica identity, creation lineage, device role, trust status, and reset history without equating a replica with a human identity.
Track happened-before, concurrency, missing events, and replica progress without forcing unreliable wall-clock ordering.
Use a proven CRDT only for data types whose merge semantics, authority, deletion, and privacy behavior have been explicitly accepted.
Present concurrent local changes, auto-converged structure, unresolved semantics, deletions, permissions, and source authority for review.
Create a source-linked briefing that restores architecture, roots, current state, gotchas, unresolved seams, and build boundaries for future collaborators.
Check schemas, digests, parent links, indexes, references, permissions, timestamps, encryption metadata, and lifecycle consistency.
Recompute object identities and prove that event, branch, snapshot, summary, and provenance links resolve to the claimed content.
Find memories, evidence, summaries, checkpoints, indexes, and branches whose required source or parent is missing.
Isolate only damaged events, files, records, or indexes while preserving healthy memory and exact repair evidence.
Migrate a reviewed memory set through reversible transforms with preconditions, exact loss report, source preservation, and rollback.
Recover interrupted memory writes through a tested journal or WAL strategy bound to exact storage version and host assumptions.
Detect truncated files, incomplete transactions, pending renames, abandoned locks, unflushed records, and mismatched commit markers.
Compare current memory-derived guidance with approved roots, intent, source facts, policies, and latest known-good checkpoint.
Show proposed reconstruction, source witnesses, uncertainty, changed records, preserved conflicts, and rollback before any repair.
Require fresh preview, exact current-state match, permission, safety copy, human confirmation, and post-restore verification.
Store verified bounded failure lessons with source, counterevidence, target profile, lifecycle, revision history, and no automatic activation.
Collect reusable continuity, retrieval, correction, merge, and recovery patterns as candidates with counterexamples and domain limits.
Report provenance completeness, freshness, contradiction, retrieval coverage, privacy, integrity, restoration proof, and human confirmation separately.
Record whether retrieved context was relevant, missing, stale, misleading, excessive, or privacy-inappropriate without silently rewriting memory.
Link an explicit correction to affected summaries, indexes, prompts, decisions, tests, exports, and downstream branches for reviewed updates.
Keep foundational roots, current working direction, experimental proposals, historical records, and rejected material in distinct authority layers.
Recheck due memories when sources, preferences, policies, environment, schemas, dependencies, or target profiles change.
Expose architecture, module history, claims, proofs, limitations, and release lineage without private identity, raw sessions, secrets, or local state.
Show branches, checkpoints, open loops, conflicts, stale memory, broken sources, retention, recovery readiness, and pending human decisions.
Coordinate capture, provenance, branching, compression, retrieval, consent, synchronization, repair, and review without gaining canon, identity, or execution authority.
